cheats.name: Start locally without server authentication
cheats.description: Allows local play when the retired server certificate is absent and skips server save restoration. Server saves are unavailable. Requires aram-core cf36a21 or newer for the full-screen framebuffer repair.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: enter the existing authentication-complete state instead of requesting a missing certificate from the retired server
call the existing local-start handler at 0x5fe80 instead of entering the server save-check prompt state
